key_findings: C65780 traps NaV1.7 in the inactivated, slowly recovering state and inhibits NaV1.7/1.8/1.9 with low micromolar IC50s.
Oral C65780 relieved pain in multiple models comparably to amitriptyline without toxicity or locomotor inhibition.
